svg.title: Source and fusion distribution divergence
svg.desc: The same illustrative paired scores, Gaussian-smoothed with bandwidth 0.08 on a shared 0 to 1 score grid. Curves show source A, source B, and the distribution of per-model 50/50 fusion results, which sits between the two sources. KL and JSD values in the text use base-2 logarithms and depend on the smoothing.
